verdict.rationale: Devin's first-party environment docs describe configuring a cloud environment once so every session boots into a known-good state. Blueprints auto-detect the tools, runtimes and dependencies a repository needs, and each cloud session runs in its own VM. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how custom setup steps and commands are defined in blueprints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of reproducibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure a reproducible cloud environment with the dependencies and setup steps my repository needs

citations.quote: Configure it once, and every session boots into that known-good state.
Devin inspects your repository, figures out which tools, runtimes, and dependencies are needed, and generates the blueprint for you.
The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access
